info.name: The True Identity of Sand Bandits

descriptions.notStarted: I have passed all the tests from all members of the Sand Bandits, and I have heard from each one of them that I deserve to be a member myself. Now I better head off to their secret residence.
descriptions.inProgress: The captain of the Sand Bandits, #b#p2101010##k, told me I have done a good job passing all the tests, and told me a story about the Sultan and the queen of #m260000000#. After he was done with the conversation, he told me to look around #m260000000# once more, and let him know when I am ready.
descriptions.completed: I have finally become a member of the Sand Bandits through #p2101010#. As a member, my job is to do my best for #m260000000#.
